_comment: Template for Antigravity's workspace MCP config. Copy to `.agents/mcp_config.json` and fill in any secrets locally. `.agents/mcp_config.json` is gitignored. See docs/agents/MCP_INTEGRATION.md for the full setup, auth, and troubleshooting walkthrough.

github._comment: GitHub's official read-only MCP server (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server). The `--read-only` flag disables every mutation tool server-side. `enabledTools` is a belt-and-braces allow-list in case the server is swapped. The token is read from the container's env; replace YOUR_GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN with a fine-scoped PAT (repo:read + metadata only for private repos; no scope needed for public). Do NOT commit the real value — only commit this .example file.

playwright._comment: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp). Browser automation for visually inspecting the dev server at localhost:5173. No credentials. `--isolated` keeps each session's browser profile clean; `--browser=chromium` pins the engine; omit `--headless` while debugging and you'll see the browser. Pin the version (e.g. 0.0.42) in your local mcp_config.json for reproducibility — `latest` is fine for a first try. See docs/agents/MCP_INTEGRATION.md for the Playwright install step (`npx playwright install chromium`).
